description: "The Liberty Bell" by William Ross Wallace is a poetic work written in the early 19th century, specifically during the Romantic period. This collection of poems centers around the themes of freedom and patriotism, using the Liberty Bell as a powerful symbol of liberty and national identity in a time of transformation and conflict in America.
